novedades: Hiperreal tanda 4: primeras piezas Pixeria (scooter 19, moto verde 20, sofá Cazafantasmas 21, sofá Matrix 22, moto custom 23, televisor de piedra 24, sofá futurista 25, sofá dragón 26 y sofá bárbaro 27).
